reason: The Currency combobox has aria-invalid=true and aria-errormessage pointing at a plain span with no live or alert role, and no aria-describedby fallback, so axe's announcement technique is missing. The accessibility tree does expose invalid=true and errormessage="Please complete this field" for the field, and the same text is visible beside it, so the error is conveyed to assistive technology that supports aria-errormessage. 4.1.2 fails only for AT that ignores aria-errormessage, which is minor.

value.name: Currency
value.template: combobox "Currency" [expanded=false, haspopup=listbox, invalid=true, errormessage=Please complete this field]

reason: Reproduced on payments.send-intl-validation: after Next, "Please complete this field" appears in a plain span with no live region, alert or status role on it or any ancestor, and focus stays on the Next button. The two live regions on the page are empty and the message container is ignored in the accessibility tree, so a screen-reader user hears nothing when the step fails to advance and must hunt for the field. 4.1.3 fails. It is a required-field message, not the only confirmation of a money movement, so it stays medium.
